human_reorganization: Base-cube exactness is proved by adjacent coordinate-path swaps and ribbon extension; the source uses an ordered path map and exact Stokes correction. The actual graph, gauges and ranks are unchanged.

Canonical geometric plaquette row signs may differ from native ribbon orientation; their energy and residual Gram are unchanged. The independent checker rebuilds all geometry and exact incidence entries.
The unpinned response certificate is identified by uniqueness of the normal residual and proved pinned/unpinned curvature-range equality, never by inverting singular A-transpose-A.
The minimum physical Rayleigh quotient is a classical compactness rephrasing of original exact form bounds. The test vector is not claimed to be an eigenvector or exact minimizer.

Numerical positivity is explicitly computer assisted: all integer data, positive weighted-Gram identities and dot products are supplied and independently checked without floating arithmetic. Complete geometric and linear-algebra implications are printed.

The separate periodic gauge and arbitrary-nonzero-coupling perturbation tests retain their own operators and hypotheses. Neither disproves a properly gauged global bound or supplies nonlinear scale/volume-uniform control.
novelty: General mechanisms classical; priority of this actual one-sided geometry and narrow rational bracket unresolved. No nonlinear gauge or physical mass-gap claim.
